name: Noda Time

scopeNotes.assembly_boundaries: One core production library only; no merged assemblies or external builds.

extra_exclusions.reason: vendored modified ReSharper annotations; source header identifies JetBrains origin and redistribution permission

scopeNotes.generated_file_policy: No additional generated C# exclusions identified; counter still excludes .g.cs and leading single-line auto-generated markers.

limitations: 379 CS0246 diagnostics all concern excluded modified JetBrains annotations or their namespace; these are not missing numeric/date implementation dependencies.
Seven DEBUG directives in two files; no project defines means Release-like branches, but not a historical build.

Calendars/Era.cs has invalid UTF-8 bytes only in XML documentation comments on lines 56 and 58; bytes preserved, counter uses .NET File.ReadAllText replacement decoding and ignores documentation comments.
LocalDate has 0/300 direct TCC while property-mediated date state remains coherent; direct-only TCC misses this relationship.
